title: Concept: Autoescaping bypassed with the safe filter in jinja — review required
description: In jinja, a value is explicitly exempted from autoescaping. Template engines escape by default, and the safe filter is the documented way to opt out. Every opt-out is a place where an upstream change that introduces user text silently becomes an injection point.
applicability: jinja templates rendered by web services.
risk: Cross-site scripting through unescaped output; MEDIUM severity.
